name: Satou Shinobu
source:
One of the cadets, later assigned to the protagonist’s unit.
She specializes in long-range artillery, steadily cornering her targets.
Though she possesses no special powers, she carries a powerful flamethrower as her trump card.

Born into a distinguished family, she is very much a refined young lady.
Among the cadets she boasts the highest marks, but her constant drive to aim ever higher gives her a tendency to look down on others.
Nevertheless, she respects the protagonist, who, despite being of common birth, commands even the daughters of the Rokukyō Families.

“I will surely become the Major’s right hand.”

[From [url=http://tech-gj.jp/products/hyakki/chara/index.html#sinobu]official website[/url]]
